item.name: Durable opaque session resolves same identity

exec: pm.test('Session matches persisted user and tenant',()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.user_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('expected_user_id'));pm.expect(d.tenant_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('expected_tenant_id'));});

pm.test('Authenticated session has CSRF and cannot be cached',()=>{const d=pm.response.json();pm.expect(d.authenticated).to.eql(true);pm.expect(Boolean(d.csrf_token)).to.eql(true);pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store');});
